name: The Mithril Kid
label: Quest
description: The Mithril Kid: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Around these parts I am known as the Mithril Kid. I supply ornate mithril to adventurers from around the world.
Little do they know that I do not know the technique to fashion ornate mithril gloves. Shhhh! This will be our little secret.
Teach me the technique to create ornate mithril gloves, friend, and in exchange, I will show you the resultant of the culmination of my training under Galvan: the ornate mithril breastplate.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you completed the crafting of the items, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for all that you have taught me, friend. The master and commander of the ornate mithril set will soon be in your possession.
